lines.en: I shift along on six short legs.
The spines on my shell sway with each step.
I crawl over the sandy shallows.
The current pushes me; I steady.
I do not get far in one step.
My spines leave fine lines in the sand.
I move like a slow stone.
Six legs labour beneath me.
I go around a clump of seagrass.
My shadow presses on the bottom.
A little sand has worked into my seams.
I creep toward deeper water.
I test the ground with each step.
This shell of mine is not light.

lines.zh: 棘刺划过水底，我转向深处。
lines.en: My spines scrape the bottom; I turn deeper.
Soft sand; good footing.
I lie on the sand like a reef rock.
All my spines stand upright.
Water flows over my shell.
I extend one spine slowly.
Sand settles on my back.
I wait for something to come near.
This is my pose of disguise.
Something moves under my shell.
I need not hide; I am simply here.
The light on the bottom wavers.
I retract a spine, then extend it.
Seagrass has tangled one leg.
I have been still for a long while.
I look like nothing but a sea urchin.
You look down; I play dead.

lines.zh: 我和旁边的石头没分别
lines.en: I am no different from the stone beside me.
Go on, put your foot near.
My spines face your way.
I rotate my shell a little.
There is more than one shadow down here.
Step on me and you will learn pain.
I keep still, but not to hide.

lines.zh: 我的六条腿全收在壳下
lines.en: All six legs are under my shell.
You cannot see how soft I am inside.
A hairline crack in my shell.
Several spines have snapped off.
I am knocked into a roll.
My six legs are struggling.
The soft flesh beneath is exposed.
This shell is thinner than I thought.
I pull myself in tighter.

lines.zh: 我的棘刺断了，海水变浑。
lines.en: My spines broke; the water clouds.
I right myself slowly.
Do not press me again.
There are scraps in the water.

lines.zh: 味道钻过棘刺，我挪了一步。
lines.en: The smell slips through my spines; I shift a step.
My six legs quicken in the sand.
This has sunk down.
I extend a spine to probe.
It is right at my mouth.
I am not picky; anything edible.
Let it sink a little further.
I open my shell's mouth.
This does not belong on the bottom.
You struck my spines.
I roll half over.
Six legs push me back upright.
Round as I am, a bump rolls me.
I hit a stone and stop.
My spines dig into the sand to hold.
Did a spine tip catch you?
I cannot retreat quickly.
Do not shove me with your hands.
That pushed us apart.
I have lowered all my spines.
Two shells rest together.
I yield a patch of sand to you.
My six legs touch yours.
The bottom is very quiet.
We creep together to the rock's seam.
Our spines cross gently.

lines.zh: 不用说话,水会带走声音
lines.en: No words; the water carries sound away.
Under shells, we are safe.
We stay right here.
I hook it closer with a spine.
I press it into the sand.

lines.zh: 硬壳卡在我的棘刺之间。
lines.en: A hard shell wedges between my spines.
I swallow it slowly.
One more thing under my shell.
It is between my legs.
I should not eat this.

lines.zh: 它滚到我的棘刺底下藏好。
lines.en: It rolls under my spines and hides.
It has a little weight.
I will keep it beneath me.
Every spine has risen.
You have entered my reach.
I turn slowly toward you.
I do not chase; I only wait.
You have stepped on my sand.
My shell mouth gapes upward.
You will remember this.
I have played stone long enough.
All six legs brace.
You are within my spines.
I turn my spines toward you, one by one.
I am slow, but my spines are not far-reaching.
I wait for you to lose footing.
The current will push you to me.
I shift an inch, and you never notice.

lines.zh: 装石头的好处是不被注意
lines.en: Playing stone means going unnoticed.
I wait for you to misplace a foot.
The sand is already trembling.
Sand still clings to my spines.

lines.zh: 我的刺与海胆很像，但不是。
lines.en: I look like a sea urchin. I'm not.
Spines drive into your sole.
I shove my whole shell forward.
All six legs push against the sand.
This blow is blunt and painful.
Two of my spines have broken.
Do not try to pull them out.
I roll and crush against you.
The sand is churned blind.
That pain will linger for days.
Blood on the spine tips.

lines.zh: 刺一点点从沙里冒出来
lines.en: Spines emerge from the sand, one by one.
Six legs brace underneath.
My whole shell lifts clear of the sand.
The water clouds in a ring.

lines.zh: 你刚才走过的地方有东西
lines.en: Something was where you just walked.
Every spine raised — don't touch.
I rotate to face forward.

lines.zh: 水底多了一块会动的礁石
lines.en: One more moving reef on the bottom.
The small fish have scattered.
You simply did not see me.
My shell burns white.
I crash onto the sand from above.
In the water, yet I feel smothered.
The blast blows my spines away.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西卡在壳缝里
lines.en: Something sharp is jammed in my seam.
That force seeps inside my shell.
My shell feels hollow and raw.
Lightning in the water numbs my spines.
There is no sand to bury in.
